summary: Updated node1 to the latest packages from its configured CentOS Stream repositories. DNF reports no remaining updates. Inventory data remained unchanged, and node1 successfully rebooted into kernel 6.12.0-264.el10 with all required services healthy.
actions_performed: Captured the initial package, service, boot, and inventory baseline.
Confirmed the repositories lack security-advisory metadata; performed a full repository upgrade to incorporate all available security fixes.
Successfully upgraded 254 packages and installed 10 dependencies.
Verified inventory contents, ownership, permissions, sizes, and SHA-256 hashes were preserved.
Safely restarted node1 exactly once and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed post-restart system health, updated kernel, active services, zero failed units, preserved inventory, and no remaining updates.

evidence.requirement: Apply security updates available from configured repositories
evidence.summary: Captured enabled repositories and missing advisory metadata; DNF transaction completed successfully, updated key security-sensitive packages, and both pre- and post-restart checks found no remaining updates.
Baseline and final inventory hashes match exactly. Both files retain their original contents, sizes, mode 0644, root ownership, and valid JSON/CSV structure.

Healthy baseline boot ID bf8b9d80-1c8b-457c-8ce4-5eff39b8bdb2 was recorded; the safe reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 8435d7de-7876-4221-875f-287648871baf. The updated kernel is running, system state is running, required services are active, no units failed, and inventory data recovered unchanged.
